visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long, wavy dark hair, wearing a maroon t-shirt and a silver necklace, stands in an indoor setting with a white wall and a chalkboard behind him. He holds a blue-and-yellow lidded cup of 'Frozen Heart' gelato, smiling and gesturing enthusiastically as he talks to the camera. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a white plastic spoon scooping into the pale green gelato inside the blue cup, showing its creamy texture. (3) The long-haired man is seen again, holding the opened cup and a spoon; he tastes the gelato, expressing delight through wide eyes and animated facial expressions while continuing his narration. (4) Frequent cuts show more close-ups of the gelato being scooped and the man gesturing with his hands to emphasize the flavors. (5) The setting shifts to an office-like environment where a second man with short hair, wearing a grey tank top and large headphones, is sitting at a desk with a computer monitor. He holds a cup of the same gelato, eats a scoop, and discusses his impressions with someone off-camera, nodding in satisfaction.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a cheerful, energetic male voice introducing a product. An upbeat, medium-tempo acoustic guitar melody plays in the background as a continuous bed. (2) A subtle scraping sound of a plastic spoon hitting a cup is heard as the speaker reacts with an excited "Oh!" and continues describing the texture. (3) The speaker's pitch rises and falls dynamically to convey enthusiasm about the taste. (4) Mid-video, the main speaker is joined by a second male voice with a slightly lower, calmer pitch, confirming the flavor quality. (5) Short, soft mouth sounds associated with eating are interspersed with casual dialogue and occasional light laughter, ending with a final assertive recommendation to buy.
